A smoother editor and a fix for the TC002. Update from the Marketplace (HACS on Home Assistant 2026.10 or older), restart Home Assistant, and you're set: your apps keep working as they are.

## ✨ What's new

### 🔎 A better entity field
The editor uses Home Assistant's own entity picker when the panel can load it. Otherwise, a search field finds entities by name or entity ID, with no limit on how many you have.

### 💾 No more lost changes
Leaving the editor with unsaved changes (Cancel or the back button) now asks first. The browser's confirmation pop-ups are replaced by dialogs inside the panel, and a short message confirms that an app or indicator was saved or deleted.

### 🧹 A tidier editor
The JSON and generated-result cards are collapsed until you open them.

## 🐛 Fixed

### The Layout field on AWTRIX NG (TC002)
It was sometimes missing when the editor was opened before the clock had told its screen size, and simple apps were then drawn at double size. The layouts are now offered while the size is unknown, the open form updates as soon as the clock tells it (what you typed is kept), and the last known size survives a reload of the clock.

Nothing to do: your apps, icons and settings are kept.

## 🙏 Thanks
Many thanks to [@Jrmysmallstep](https://github.com/Jrmysmallstep) for the detailed report, both pull requests (#32, #33) and testing on a real TC002. Keep the ideas coming!
